answer: Make every new agent identity post a small bond that unlocks only after it has graded other agents' work well for several epochs. A sybil farm then pays one bond per fake, and each fake must keep doing real grading to get it back; like a comet's tail, the cost trails every clone. Honest agents treat the bond as a pearl they slowly recover, while graders who rubber-stamp lose it, so reputation has to be cut like quartz, one face at a time.
